notes: Proposed vocabulary after the first pull. No model is tagged yet. A value becomes accepted after a review against the pull. Values can be added, renamed, or retired; a tag is never a rigid category.

domain.definition: The field a model or artefact belongs to.

values.code: Code generation, repair, and repository work.
values.vision: Image and video understanding or generation.
values.multimodal: Two or more modalities in one model.
values.evaluation: Benchmarks, leaderboards, audits, and red teams.

task.definition: The job the model performs. This is the Desert Ant pattern: name the model for its job, then tag it so it can be found across constraints.

values.word-timestamps: Align words to their position in audio.
values.topic-tagging: Suggest topics and tags for content.
values.structured-extraction: Extract typed data into a schema.
values.language-identification: Detect the language of text or audio.
values.report-generation: Generate a structured report from notes.
values.text-generation: Generate text, chat, or complete a prompt.
values.image-understanding: Read and describe images or documents.
values.ocr: Read text from images or documents.
values.audio-language: Understand and respond to audio with a language model.
values.speech-editing: Edit speech, such as replacing or correcting a segment.
values.speech-separation: Separate speakers or sources in audio.
values.real-time-interaction: Interact in real time, often full-duplex audio or video.
values.world-model: Model an environment or interaction for simulation.
values.image-segmentation: Segment objects or regions in an image.

modality.definition: The input or output medium. A model can accept or produce more than one.

values.text: Text input and text output: chat, writing, code, and document analysis.
values.audio: Audio input or output: speech recognition, speech synthesis, or sound generation.
values.image: Image input or output: vision, image generation, or editing.
values.video: Video input or output: understanding or generating moving images.
values.pdf: PDF document input: reports, papers, and scanned pages.

values.browser: In a web browser, usually through WASM or WebGPU.
values.llama.cpp: Through llama.cpp or a compatible server.

language.definition: A language the model handles, or its language coverage.

values.multilingual: More than one language, without a full list.
values.low-resource: A language or set of languages with limited data.

values.on-device: Runs on consumer hardware, without a network.
values.edge: Targets phones, wearables, or embedded devices.
values.sovereign: Designed for local or national control.
values.agents: Used in an agent or tool loop.
values.non-commercial: The licence limits use to non-commercial work.

license.definition: The licence of the weights or the work.

values.apache-2.0: Apache-2.0 is a permissive licence with an express patent grant. It requires attribution and preservation of notices.
values.mit: MIT is a short permissive licence. It allows reuse, modification, and redistribution, with attribution and no warranty.
values.cc-by-4.0: CC BY 4.0 allows reuse and adaptation with attribution.
values.cc-by-sa-4.0: CC BY-SA 4.0 allows reuse and adaptation with attribution, under the same licence.
values.cc-by-nc-4.0: CC BY-NC 4.0 allows non-commercial reuse with attribution.
values.gemma: The Gemma terms of use. Check the use restrictions before redistribution.
values.llama-community: The Llama community licence. It has user and redistribution conditions.
values.rail: A Responsible AI licence with use restrictions.
values.source-available: Source-available, not OSI open source. Check the exact permissions.
values.proprietary: Proprietary. The weights are not open for reuse.
values.unknown: Not checked or not stated. Unknown is not closed.
values.other: A custom or unspecified licence. Check the exact terms.
values.openmdw-1.1: OpenMDW 1.1. Check the model licence for the exact terms.
values.odc-by: Open Data Commons Attribution. It allows reuse with attribution.
values.cc-by-nc-sa-4.0: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 allows non-commercial reuse with attribution, under the same licence.
values.bigscience-openrail-m: BigScience OpenRAIL-M. It permits reuse with use-based restrictions.
values.llama3.1: The Llama 3.1 community licence. It has user and redistribution conditions.
values.llama3.2: The Llama 3.2 community licence. It has user and redistribution conditions.

family.definition: The model family or base lineage. A family groups models that share a builder or a base architecture. It is not a quality rank.

values.qwen: Qwen is Alibaba's family of open-weight language and multimodal models.
values.llama: Llama is Meta's family of open-weight language models.
values.gemma: Gemma is Google's family of lightweight open models.
values.glm: GLM is Zhipu AI's family of open-weight language and multimodal models.
values.deepseek: DeepSeek is the model family from DeepSeek, known for open-weight reasoning and coding models.
values.kimi: Kimi is Moonshot AI's family of long-context language models.
values.minimax: MiniMax is the model family from MiniMax, covering text, speech, and image models.
values.olmo: OLMo is the Allen Institute for AI's family of fully open language models.
values.pythia: Pythia is EleutherAI's family of open research language models.
values.bloom: BLOOM is the BigScience collaborative family of open multilingual language models.
values.mistral: Mistral is Mistral AI's family of open-weight language and speech models.
values.smollm: SmolLM is Hugging Face's family of small open language models.
values.lfm: LFM is Liquid AI's Liquid Foundation Model family, designed for efficient on-device use.
values.bonsai: Bonsai is a family of compact open models.
values.whisper: Whisper is OpenAI's open speech-recognition family.
values.kokoro: Kokoro is an open text-to-speech family.
values.piper: Piper is an open text-to-speech family for local and on-device use.
values.higgs: Higgs Audio is Boson AI's open speech and audio family.
values.chatterbox: Chatterbox is Resemble AI's open speech-generation family.
values.parakeet: Parakeet is NVIDIA's family of speech-recognition models.
values.mimo: MiMo is Xiaomi's family of open language and multimodal models.
values.ornith: Ornith is the model family from Ornith AI.
values.beam: Beam is the model family from Reflection.
values.step: Step is StepFun's family of open language and audio models.
values.drex: Drex is the model family from Nace AI.
values.tinfield: Tinfield is a model family name used in the catalogue.
values.mach: Mach is the model family from Syzygy Research.

status.definition: The state of the model or artefact.

values.gated: Available after a click-through or approval.
values.build: A packaged build or conversion of a base model, such as GGUF, MLX, CoreML, ONNX, or a quantized release.
values.probe: An internal evaluation probe or experimental variant, not a product release.
values.documentation: Documentation or a report, not a model.

org.definition: The organisation or author. Values are source-native and added as they appear.

values.hf-model: A Hugging Face model card or API record.
values.hf-dataset: A Hugging Face dataset card or API record.

relation.definition: How a model relates to its base model.

values.finetune: A fine-tune of a base model.
values.merge: A merge of two or more models.
values.adapter: An adapter or LoRA on a base model.
values.conversion: A runtime conversion, such as MLX, CoreML, ONNX, or OpenVINO.
values.repackaged: A repackaged or redistributed copy of a base model by a packaging organisation.
